links.comparator_used: Uncorrected automatic DL contours, each compared against manual delineation
links.outcome: Contour agreement with manual delineation (DSC, 95%HD, sDSC) and clinical acceptability
links.effect: Mean DSC for right-sided CTVp was 0.92 ± 0.06 before correction; correction statistically significantly improved it by only 0.02 ± 0.05. 92% of auto-contours were scored clinically acceptable, with or without corrections.
links.tradeoff: Correction adds editing time. Even so, auto-segmentation including correction cut time versus manual delineation in 95% of cases (OARs 42.4% ± 26.5%, CTVs 58.5% ± 19.1%; mean absolute reduction 00:08:51 and 00:25:38).
links.quote: Good quantitative results were achieved before correction, e.g. mean DSC for the right-sided CTVp was 0.92 ± 0.06, whereas correction statistically significantly improved this contour by only 0.02 ± 0.05, respectively.

design_hint: clinician review and manual contour adjustment
